fixturePolicy.plaintextPublication: Evidence records carry commitments, case ids and outcome counts only, never candidate values, spans or sanitized text.
fixturePolicy.expectations: Identity, sensitivity and action are authored from the frozen family contract and pii-context/v1 before any scan; detector output never edits them.
fixturePolicy.massAssumption: Declared base-rate mass is an explicit assumption per stratum, not an operational prevalence claim; it is never renormalized.
fixturePolicy.sensitiveExamples: Independent hand-authored local parts and invented non-delegated domains (.synthetic, .fixture) with no real-world provenance; they assert nothing about any mailbox, person or domain.
fixturePolicy.reservedControls: Non-sensitive controls use only RFC 2606 documentation domains and RFC 6761 special-use names.
fixturePolicy.publicRole: Public role/contact addresses are synthetic role mailboxes under invented domains, not real organizations.
fixturePolicy.credentials: Credential overlap uses placeholder connection-string passwords only; no provider token or real credential is stored.
